title: seq by Vic Layton
lyrics_synced: [00:03.68] Camp town la dies sing this song, \Doo dah, Doo dah, Camp town ra ce track five miles long, \Oh Doo dah day! \I came down here with my hat caved in, \Doo dah, Doo dah, \I go back home with a pocket full of tin, \Oh Doo dah, Day! \Gon na run all night, Gon na run all day, \I bet my mo ney on the bob tail nag, \Some body bet on the bay! \The long tail filly and the big black hoss, \Doo dah, Doo dah, \They fly the track and they cut accross, \Oh Doo day day! \The blind hoss stuck in a big black hole, \Doo dah, Doo dah, \I can't touch bottom with a tenfoot pole, \Oh Doo dah, Day! \Gon na run all night, Gon na run all day, \I bet my mo ney on the bob tail nag, \Some body bet on the bay.
